name: Cunning Mechanic
body:
You rely on a keen understanding rather than nimble fingers when dealing with machines.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Craft (mechanical) 1 rank

Benefit(s): You use your Intelligence modifier rather than your Dexterity modifier on Disable Device checks.
